12. Melchiſedech † S. Hicrom being carneſtly requcſted by Euagrius, to
endeuored to proue to be the Holie Ghoſt, plainly confuteth that error: as alſo concerning:
an other error of Origen and Didymus ſaying, he was an Angel. Likewiſe S. Melchiſederh :
Epiphanius (bereſ: 55. & 2e) relateth and condemneth a third error, of ſome
that thought him to be the Sonne of God. Theſe two Fathers, and S. Auguſtin
† li: de hereſibus her. 34.) and diuers others, whom S. Hierom alleageth proue
euidently, that he was a very man, a Prieſt and a king, yea the hiegh Prieſt
